data.name: PUBLIC, an Ian Schrager hotel
data.headline: Upscale hotel near New York University
data.description:
Washington Square Park and Manhattan Bridge are located near PUBLIC, an Ian Schrager hotel, which provides a nightclub, a rooftop terrace, and shopping on site. Be sure to enjoy Peruvian cuisine and more at the two on-site restaurants. Fitness classes are offered at the 24-hour health club; the property also has a coffee shop/cafe, a garden, and dry cleaning/laundry services. In addition to a fireplace in the lobby and 6 bars, guests can connect to free WiFi in public areas.
You'll also find perks like:
Full breakfast (surcharge), self parking (surcharge), and express check-out
Express check-in, an elevator, and wedding services
3 meeting rooms, concierge services, and a water dispenser
Guest reviews give top marks for the helpful staff and proximity to shopping
Room features
All 367 rooms boast comforts such as premium bedding and laptop-compatible safes, as well as thoughtful touches like air conditioning. Guest reviews highly rate the clean rooms at the property.
Other amenities include:
Hypo-allergenic bedding, Egyptian cotton sheets, and pillowtop mattresses
Bathrooms with free toiletries and hair dryers
Flat-screen TVs with premium channels
Wardrobes/closets, refrigerators, and free infant beds

data.area_description: In the entertainment district, PUBLIC, an Ian Schrager hotel is in Manhattan, a walkable area in New York with great shopping. Radio City Music Hall and Broadway Theatre are cultural highlights, and some of the area's notable landmarks include Brooklyn Bridge and One World Trade Center. Looking to enjoy an event or a game? See what's going on at Madison Square Garden or Barclays Center Brooklyn.
